claim: NVIDIA's fiscal second quarter 2024 gross profit was its highest ever, at $10.2 billion.
summary: NVIDIA's FY2024 Q2 was a record quarter at the time, but its gross profit was ~$9.5B, not $10.2B, so the stated amount is false.

sub_claims.text: NVIDIA's fiscal second quarter 2024 gross profit was $10.2 billion
sub_claims.note: From model knowledge: NVIDIA FY2024 Q2 ended July 30, 2023 with revenue ~$13.5 billion and GAAP gross margin ~70.1%, implying GAAP gross profit ~$9.5 billion, not $10.2 billion.

sub_claims.text: NVIDIA's fiscal second quarter 2024 gross profit was its highest quarterly gross profit to that date
sub_claims.note: From model knowledge: FY2024 Q2 gross profit ~$9.5B did exceed all prior quarters to that date, so it was a record at the time, though it is no longer the all-time high as of 2026 because later quarters were much larger.
